ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
API Key authentication using X-API-Key header.
API keys must be prefixed with `sk_live_`.
All API keys are organization-level only.
Include the API key in the X-API-Key header as: `X-API-Key: <api_key>`
Get your API key from the [dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys](https://dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys).

UserAccessToken.description:
User's Access Token authentication using Bearer token.
Include the token in the Authorization header as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
This authentication method is used for API Key management endpoints.
Users must have admin or owner role in the organization to manage API keys.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

code.description:
Machine-readable error code for programmatic error handling.
Common error codes:
- `authentication_required`: Missing or invalid authentication token (401)
- `insufficient_permissions`: User lacks required permissions (403)
- `not_found`: Requested resource not found (404)
- `invalid_request`: Request body validation failed (400)
- `invalid_pagination`: Pagination parameters are invalid (400)
- `create_error`: Failed to create resource (500)
- `update_error`: Failed to update resource (500)
- `delete_error`: Failed to delete resource (500)
- `list_error`: Failed to list resources (500)
- `service_error`: Internal service error (500)

details.description: Additional error details (optional, structure varies by error type)

devices.description:
List of device IDs associated with the card.
Each device_id must be registered within the organization.
Device IDs can only contain lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

effective_at.description:
Effective time (when the card becomes active).
Must be the current time or a future time.
Default: UTC, recommended to use the format `2025-02-16T12:00:00+01:00` to ensure the correct time zone.
About ISO 8601: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601

invalid_at.description:
Invalidation time (when the card becomes invalid/expires).
Must be the current time or a future time.
Default: UTC, recommended to use the format `2025-02-16T12:00:00+01:00` to ensure the correct time zone.
About ISO 8601: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601

permissions.description: Allowed Permissions (scope:role format) for the API key

allowed_ips.description: Allowed IP ranges (CIDR) for this API key

allowed_tenants.description:
List of tenant IDs that this API key can access.
If empty or null, the API key can access all tenants within the organization.
If specified, the API key can only access the listed tenants.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the API key

subject_id.description:
This can be a tenant_id or organization_id. The API key will be scoped to this organization or tenant.
DEPRECATED: This field is automatically set from the URL path and will be removed in a future version.
Do not provide this field in the request body.

created_by.description:
User identifier of the user who created the API key.
DEPRECATED: This field is automatically set from the authenticated user and will be removed in a future version.
Do not provide this field in the request body.

ttl.description: TTL of the API key in seconds. If not set, the default TTL is used.

apikey_id.description: Unique identifier for the API key (external ID)

organization_id.description: Organization ID that owns this API key

is_suspended.description:
Whether the API key is suspended due to billing or policy reasons.
Suspended API keys cannot be used but remain visible in the system.
This is different from deletion - suspended keys can be reactivated.

suspension_reason.description:
Reason why the API key is suspended (e.g. billing, policy_violation).
This field is only set when the API key is suspended for billing or policy reasons,
not when it is deleted by the user.

expires_at.description:
Expiration time based on created_at and ttl.
Returns null if ttl is null (key never expires).

secret_key.description:
Secret key for the API key. Only returned on creation.
This is the only time the full secret key will be available.
Prefix: `sk_live_` for production.

ApiKeyHeader.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyHeader.description:
API Key for authentication. Get your API key from [dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys](https://dash.stayforge.io/settings/apikeys). 
API keys must be prefixed with either `sk_org_` (organization-level) or `sk_ten_` (tenant-level).

AuthorizationHeader.name: Authorization
AuthorizationHeader.description:
User's Access Token for authentication. 
Include the token in the Authorization header as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
This authentication method is used for API Key management endpoints.
Users must have admin or owner role in the organization to manage API keys.

PageQuery.name: page
PageQuery.description:
Page number (starts from 1). 
Pagination is mandatory for list endpoints to prevent performance issues.
Default: 1

LimitQuery.name: limit
LimitQuery.description:
Number of items per page (1-100). 
Pagination is mandatory for list endpoints to prevent performance issues.
Default: 20, Maximum: 100
